values.note: Overnight RV sites $25 a night; tent-only sites $20. Up to 6 people and 2 licensed vehicles (trailers count) per site; further vehicles park by the office. Cancellation costs $10; none refunded within 48 hours.

values.note: Mostly seasonal: 47 of the 64 RV sites (2-53) are seasonal; 16 overnight RV sites (46-70, site 62 the pull-through) and one accessible site (16) are sold by the night, beside 13 tent-only sites and 6 camper cabins. Most overnight pads are described as large; site 46 is a smaller corner site.

values.note: Online booking on the park's own site, by site; a requested site number is not guaranteed. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 2 p.m.; late arrivals find their site in an envelope on the registration building.

note: Redwood County's only county park, just west of Walnut Grove, on Plum Creek with the swimming lake Lake Laura; trails around the lake and along the creek, disc golf. Mostly seasonal: most of its RV sites are rented for the season, with a block of overnight sites at the south end. --Claude
summary: County site read: 64 RV sites of which 47 seasonal, 16 overnight (+1 accessible), 13 tent-only, 6 cabins; $25 RV (30/50-amp, no water/sewer), $20 tent; 6 people / 2 vehicles per site; season May-September; own online booking engine; showers, flush toilets, store, paid Wi-Fi. Fees re-confirmed, sites/hookups/facilities/season/booking written, note rewritten. Long-stay tests pass (mostly seasonal). Not waterfront kept.
flags: Long-stay (county park, mostly seasonal): 47 of 64 RV sites are seasonal. (1) $25 a night; (2) nightly rate posted and the county's own engine books single overnight sites; (3) no minimum stay posted; (4) nightly share 16 RV + 1 accessible + 13 tent-only = 30 of 77 campsites (~39%), well over 1 in 10; (5) a county park, no homes or lots. Pass; the note says it is mostly seasonal. RV Life 4.5. County-run, so no Google rating needed.
Season written from month-level wording ('Open May – September'; the home page still says '2025 Season'): opens 05-01, closes 09-30 as approximations, said so in season.note.
Sites: count 72 (derived, RV + primitive) -> 64 RV sites. Only the 16 overnight RV sites + 1 accessible site are bookable by a traveller.

Waterfront: keep not waterfront. The RV loops sit in woods east of Lake Laura's marshy inlet and Plum Creek; the only sites the county describes as 'overlooking Lake Laura' are the tent-only primitive sites outside the campground.

Pin 44.20650,-95.49700 is in the crop field just south-east of the campground (~180 m from the overnight block); the overnight sites are at about 44.2073,-95.4990 and the campground centre about 44.2077,-95.4984. Under 250 m; optional move.
Phone 507-859-2005 (Redwood County Environmental Office / park) and website https://plumcreekpark.com/ confirmed.
Facilities: dump true kept (the county's map shows a Dump Station beside sites 64-65). Laundry (derived from the sweep note) appears on no county page or the campground map -> cleared to unknown.
